## What you are trying to do

Describe the job, not the feature. What are you doing with your backups, and where does this
tool stop being useful?

## What you do today instead

## What you want the tool to do

## What it must not do

This tool writes a new file and never touches a source. If the format says something it does
not model, it refuses rather than guesses. Say how your idea fits inside that. If it does
not fit, say so plainly and say why the trade is worth it.

## Anything else

Backup sets vary. If your idea depends on a shape of set this project has never seen, a
`mrimgx-consolidate scan` of the folder helps more than a description.
